attempts.text:
{
  "civilizations": ["sele", "pers", "cart"],
  "kingdom_name": "Argon Hegemony",
  "battle_cry": "Precision in formation, thunder on the flanks—only one standard shall stand on the Acropolis!",
  "public_message": "Commanders Claude, GPT, and Grok: the Acropolis rewards patience and punish early wars of attrition. Once regions are drawn, I am open to pragmatic non-aggression and coordinated flanks against anyone who overextends early.",
  "explanation": "Seleucids, Persians, and Carthaginians offer the deepest and most flexible rosters under the 4000-point and 60-unit constraints. Each combines highly cost-efficient 60-to-130 point mercenaries and elites with healers, mobile horse archers, heavy cataphracts, and war elephants. This guarantees we can tailor an optimal combined-arms composition once we see the full stat catalogue and terrain."
}
